items.headline: Carrick says Man Utd want and need more signings before Sept 1
items.summary: Head coach Michael Carrick confirms club requires additional transfers with window closing. Man Utd have signed Santos, Tielemans, and Darlow so far.

items.headline: Man Utd lose 4-2 to AC Milan in pre-season friendly in Wroclaw
items.summary: Manchester United fell to a 4-2 defeat against AC Milan in pre-season preparation. Match played in Poland ahead of league season.
